About BCF Lanka
A shared purpose.
A better tomorrow.
Giving waste a productive purpose, with the ambition to create prosperity and well-being for people and our planet.
Build the future with us →
People. Resources. A brighter Sri Lanka.
Our purpose
Two city challenges.
One shared purpose.
Waste pollution and the need for cleaner energy are connected challenges. BCF LANKA’s approach brings them together: recover useful fuels and materials from non-recyclable waste, and return those resources to productive use.
Our purpose is to help move Sri Lanka towards a circular economy, where materials retain value and waste becomes a resource rather than a burden.
Our approach
Recovery with a purpose.
A connected approach to materials, energy and the communities around them.
01Start with the waste challenge
Focus on non-recyclable waste and the opportunity to divert suitable materials from disposal and open burning.
02Recover useful resources
Use thermal conversion to recover oil, gas and carbon-rich material, with applications assessed against their properties.
03Work towards lasting value
Connect resource recovery with industrial needs and opportunities for local participation and economic activity.
Leadership & dialogue
Progress starts
with a conversation.
Successful resource recovery brings together technical, commercial and local perspectives. For leadership enquiries, company information or an introduction to the team responsible for your area of interest, please contact BCF LANKA directly.

Our technology

Thermal conversion gives suitable non-recyclable materials a route back into productive use.
Preparation. Conversion. Recovery. Reuse.
Understanding pyrolysis
A different pathway
for difficult materials.
Pyrolysis is thermal decomposition in an oxygen-limited environment. Heat breaks down suitable feedstock into smaller compounds, producing gas, condensable liquids and a solid carbon-rich fraction.
BCF LANKA’s existing material describes thermal conversion of non-recyclable waste into useful fuels and materials. Feedstock assessment, operating conditions and product testing are important to understanding any specific application.
Discuss material compatibility and project-specific requirements with the technical team. This overview does not prescribe operating temperatures, capacities or product specifications.
From process to purpose

of the whole picture.
Responsible application also depends on the material coming in, the products going out and the way a facility operates.

Discuss waste composition, contaminants and preparation before assuming that a material can be accepted.
Product assessment

Project requirements

Our products
Valuable resources.
New possibilities.
Oil, gas and char: three recovered fractions with potential uses beyond their first life as waste.
Discuss your requirements →
01 / Liquid resource
Pyrolysis oil
A recovered liquid fraction with potential as an alternative industrial fuel.
Characteristics
Oil is recovered by condensing part of the vapour produced during thermal conversion. Its composition depends on the feedstock and processing conditions.
Potential applications
Industrial fuel applications may be considered where the product meets equipment, quality and regulatory requirements. Suitability needs to be assessed for each use.
Ask about specifications and availability →
02 / Energy resource
Recovered gas
Recovering energy within waste for potential process use.
Characteristics
The non-condensable gas fraction is produced alongside oil and char. Its composition and usable energy depend on the materials and conversion conditions.
Potential applications
Recovered gas may provide process heat where an appropriate system is designed for it. Ask the technical team about process integration and handling requirements.
Explore process fuel opportunities →
03 / Material resource
Recovered char
A carbon-rich solid fraction with potential industrial uses.
Characteristics
The solid fraction retains carbon and other constituents from the feedstock. Composition, ash content and physical properties require characterisation.
Potential applications
Potential industrial and environmental uses depend on testing and application requirements. It should not be assumed suitable for soil use or equivalent to certified biochar.
Discuss material suitability →

Tell us about your intended use, equipment requirements and the information you need. Our team can discuss available specifications, testing, sample requests and supply enquiries.

Explore Lindel Industrial Park ↓
A vision for resource recovery in Sri Lanka.
Project focus
Lindel
Industrial Park
Sri Lanka
Lindel Industrial Park is the project location featured in BCF LANKA’s existing material. It brings the company’s resource-recovery approach into an industrial context, connecting waste preparation, thermal conversion and recovered products.
The project’s purpose is to demonstrate how suitable non-recyclable waste could become useful fuels and materials, while exploring opportunities for industrial integration.
For the current development stage, operational status, approvals, capacity or a potential site visit, please request a project update directly from BCF LANKA. The imagery on this website is illustrative and is not evidence of completion or operation.
Request a project update →

How this website handles information and what happens when you make an enquiry.
Website use
Your enquiries

Hosting
Contact
Using this website
You can browse this website without creating an account. The website does not ask for personal information unless you choose to complete an enquiry or contact BCF LANKA.
Making an enquiry
The contact form prepares an email using the name, email address, organisation, topic and message you enter. Preparation happens in your browser. The form does not submit this information to a website database or an online form-processing service.
Your email application opens with a draft, and you decide whether to send it. When you send an email, the message and associated sender information pass through your email provider and the recipient’s email service. They are then available to BCF LANKA to respond to your enquiry.
Only include information needed for the conversation. Do not include confidential business records, identity documents or sensitive personal information in an initial enquiry.
Cookies and browser storage
This website’s application code does not set analytics or advertising cookies, use tracking pixels, or store enquiry details in local storage. Information typed into the form remains in the current page until navigation, although your browser may independently offer autofill or retain form state.
If you use “Copy enquiry”, the prepared message is placed on your clipboard only after you choose that action.
Website hosting
The hosting provider may process standard technical request information, such as an IP address, requested URL and browser information, to deliver and secure the website. Those processes depend on the hosting configuration and provider’s policies.
Questions about your information
For questions about an enquiry you have sent, or to ask about access, correction or deletion of that information, email info@bcflanka.com
. Do not send sensitive information to verify a request unless an appropriate method has been agreed.
This notice describes the website functionality provided here. Company-wide retention arrangements and any legal requirements should be confirmed directly with BCF LANKA.
